title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Joshua 10: the five kings against Gibeon, the sun standing still, and the cave at Makkedah.

questions.text: Adoni-Zedek was king of which city?
questions.explanation: The text calls Adoni-Zedek the king of Jerusalem.

questions.text: Which city did Adoni-Zedek ask the other kings to help him strike?
questions.explanation: Adoni-Zedek asked the kings to come and strike Gibeon, because it had made peace with Joshua and Israel.

questions.text: How did Joshua reach the kings' armies?
questions.explanation: Joshua came to them suddenly; he marched from Gilgal all night.

answers.text: He waited three days and came by day
He sent the Gibeonites ahead alone
He went around by way of the Jordan
He marched from Gilgal all night and came suddenly

questions.text: What killed more of the fleeing enemies than the swords of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky, and more died from the hailstones than by the sword.

questions.text: In Joshua's words, where was the moon to stop?
questions.explanation: Joshua told the sun to stand still on Gibeon and the moon to stop in the valley of Aijalon.

questions.text: In which book does the text say the sun standing still is written?
questions.explanation: The text asks whether this is not written in the book of Jashar.

answers.text: The book of the law of Moses

questions.text: Where did the five kings hide?
questions.explanation: The five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

questions.text: What did the chiefs of the men of war put on the necks of the kings?
questions.explanation: Joshua told the chiefs to come near and put their feet on the necks of these kings, and they did.

questions.text: Who came up to help Lachish?
questions.explanation: Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish, and Joshua struck him and his people.

questions.text: Why did Joshua take all these kings and their land at one time?
questions.explanation: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

answers.text: Because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel
Because the Gibeonites fought for him
Because the kings were fighting each other
